instruction: Use the peg to poke the cube into the goal region.

outcome.real_measurement: Rationale: the task's own goal radius (goal_radius = 0.05 m), cube centre xy to goal centre xy, averaged over the last 0.5 s. Real world: top camera, cube centroid vs the printed target via table-plane homography.

Rationale: the instruction is tool use, so no robot link (fingers, hand, arm) may touch the cube: robot-cube pairwise contact force > 0.05 N in zero control steps. Real world: fingertip tactile pads + wrist F/T with the peg's own load subtracted, gated by camera proximity of the hand to the cube; or a contact microphone / IMU in the cube attributing the impact to the peg via the peg-tip track.

Rationale: the cube must be moved by the peg: peg-cube contact force > 0.05 N in at least one control step. Real world: camera track of the peg head touching the cube face (distance < 5 mm) while the cube moves, or F/T force along the peg axis when the peg is grasped.

counterexamples.name: gripper_push
counterexamples.description: ignore the peg, push the cube with the tilted closed gripper

counterexamples.name: peg_poke
counterexamples.description: positive control: grasp the peg, poke the cube onto the goal

source.released_code_predicate: success = is_cube_placed & is_robot_static; is_peg_cube_fit / is_peg_grasped computed, unused

notes: Holding the peg at the end is allowed (require_released false). Contacts are taken from the last PhysX substep of each 20 Hz control step.
